write.scope: MicroClay familiarity/retrieval context identity and retrieval-wide credit attribution boundary

source_crosschecks: MicroClay._entry_keys uses kind, subject and hashed query/value cue intersections; state/intent/affect are not explicit entry-key dimensions in the inspected donor span.
retrieve records turn/episode/causal/session/generation identities but persists one capped union of selected-item entry_keys for the retrieval episode.
_apply_credit applies the retrieval-level credit to every key in that episode-wide union.
kreditsignal_mechanisch explicitly classifies mention-based credit as a utility hypothesis, not a measured usefulness fact.
DEFAULT_MODE is SHADOW; baseline remains serving unless an explicit promotion changes the policy mode.

architecture_result.trigger4_handoff: SHADOW-only per-candidate context instrumentation plus lexical-constant counterbalance, context-shuffle and context-lesion tests before any serving promotion

parallel_reconciliation.reason: The design branch is moving under parallel append-only Triggerword-5 work and the aggregate INGEST_STATE snapshot lagged newer committed deltas. Replacing the full state here could erase concurrent lineage.

next_exact_gate: Triggerword-4 implements FamiliarityContextBinding/v1 in SHADOW with per-candidate attribution and held-out shuffle/lesion controls; Triggerword-5 re-enters newest inbox and then inspects the next nonduplicate sparse-world-substrate source span.
